settings.title: Enable wireless CarPlay
settings.description: Enable Bluetooth handover, Wi-Fi audio, hotspot-scoped CarPlay firewall rules, Now Playing and Device Connections. Turning this off does not remove global projection feature flags.

settings.title: Automatically open CarPlay
settings.description: Open CarPlay once when a wireless session connects.

settings.title: Integrated turn-by-turn
settings.description: Enable built-in cluster guidance, stock turn formatting and experimental intersection detail. Leave off with Standalone TBT.

settings.title: Extended session diagnostics
settings.description: Include detailed native CarPlay logs in automatic WCP-LOGS session exports. Basic Java session journals are always collected. Native logs may contain private device information.

settings.title: Kia K5 gasoline vehicle identity
settings.description: Opt in only on a gasoline Kia K5. Advertise Kia K5 and gasoline engine type without EV charging connectors. Off preserves OEM vehicle identity and allows existing companion EV contributions.

settings.title: RC7 unconditional vehicle groups
settings.description: Force both OEM vehicle capability flags even without a vehicle contribution.

settings.title: RC7 dynamic identity callbacks
settings.description: Select the OEM callback dynamically instead of RC6 fixed lookup.

settings.title: RC7 replace theme fields
settings.description: Replace existing theme parameters rather than RC6 legacy append.

settings.title: RC7 capability sizing probe
settings.description: Enable the RC7 duplicate-detection sizing probe instead of bounded RC6 append.

settings.title: RC7 identity rearm lifecycle
settings.description: Shut down the native gate before replacing an active contribution.

settings.title: RC7 early StartSession
settings.description: Allow preparation before a network address is known.

settings.title: RC7 optional receiver version
settings.description: Allow StartSession without a measured receiver source version.

settings.title: RC7 omit unknown Wi-Fi channel
settings.description: Omit an unknown channel instead of encoding zero.

settings.title: RC7 omit empty address list
settings.description: Omit the address-list field when empty (only matters with early StartSession).

settings.title: RC7 directory session recorder
settings.description: Use the categorized RC7 session recorder instead of the legacy journal. Independent startup recording remains active.
